scope: Readiness waits for model inference preparation before microphone capture. These native measurements use cached installed weights in an isolated models directory, not a timed clean-machine installation.

detector_first_second_comparison.method: 40 fresh benchmark processes using the cached model and production SpeechPresenceDetector. OS/model caches were not purged; not a first-install compilation measurement. Each process calls the detector 10 times on the same clip. Prewarm runs one silent 4096-sample inference on the same instance first.

limits: Wall-clock latency can still differ under contention and for different audio lengths.
The new CTC test location incurred approximately 15 seconds of first preparation; this is not a normal per-dictation cost.
Battery and processor utilization percentages were not profiled.
No user microphone recordings, settings, history, or clipboard were used by native model tests.

verification.ui_preparation: passed; includes installed but disabled S1, capture gating, idle reload and changing selection
verification.ui_onboarding: passed; includes waiting for first preparation and retry without downloading again
